name: ALEX RIVERA
summaries: Data Analyst with 2 years of experience turning raw operational and sales data into dashboards, forecasts and recommendations that teams act on.
Financial Analyst experienced in budgeting, variance analysis and forecasting, building models in Excel and SQL that support monthly business reviews.
Business Operations Analyst who maps processes, tracks KPIs and finds the root cause of delays, using SQL, Python and Tableau.
Analytics professional with an MS in Business Analytics, comfortable across SQL, Python and BI tools and in presenting findings to non-technical leaders.
skills: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Excel (PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query)
PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery, ETL, data cleaning, data modeling
Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, month-end reporting, unit economics
A/B testing, regression, cohort analysis, time series forecasting
KPI design, process mapping, root cause analysis, stakeholder communication

experience.title: Data Analyst
experience.org: Harbor Home Goods (retail, fictional) | Los Angeles, CA
bullets: Built a Tableau sales dashboard on Snowflake used in weekly reviews by 14 store and category managers.
Wrote dbt models that replaced 6 manual Excel reports, cutting weekly reporting time from 5 hours to 30 minutes.
Ran a cohort analysis on 220K loyalty members that showed repeat purchase dropped 18% after the second order, leading to a new follow-up email.
Designed an A/B test of free-shipping thresholds across 40K checkouts; the winning version raised average order value by 6%.
Forecast weekly demand for 300 top items in Python, lowering stockouts in the pilot region by 11%.
Cleaned and joined point-of-sale, web and inventory data in SQL into one daily table used by the analytics team.

experience.title: Financial Analyst Intern
bullets: Prepared monthly budget vs. actual reports for 5 departments and explained variances above 5% to department heads.
Built an Excel cost-per-shipment model that found $240K a year in duplicate carrier charges.
Automated the month-end accrual workbook with Power Query, saving the team about 2 days each close.
Reconciled 1,200 vendor invoices a month against the ERP and flagged mismatches to accounts payable.
Built a 13-week cash flow forecast in Excel that the controller used in weekly planning.

experience.title: Operations Assistant
bullets: Tracked scheduling and attendance for 90 tutors in Google Sheets and built a weekly utilization report.
Mapped the student sign-up process and removed two steps, cutting average sign-up time from 4 days to 1.

projects.title: NYC Taxi Demand Forecast
bullets: Queried 30M public taxi trips in BigQuery and built hourly demand features by zone and weather.
Compared Prophet and gradient boosting forecasts; the better model cut error (MAPE) from 21% to 13% on held-out weeks.
Published a notebook and short write-up explaining where the model fails, such as holidays and storms.

projects.title: SaaS Revenue and Churn Model
bullets: Built a three-statement style revenue model for a sample subscription business with new, expansion and churned revenue.
Ran sensitivity tables on price and churn to show which drivers move annual recurring revenue the most.
Wrote SQL to compute monthly logo and revenue churn from raw subscription events.

projects.title: Hospital Wait Time Dashboard
bullets: Modeled a public emergency-room dataset into a star schema and built a Power BI report of wait times by hour and triage level.
Found that 60% of long waits happened in a 4-hour evening window and suggested a staffing shift to cover it.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation
bullets: Clustered 4,000 public online-retail customers with RFM features and k-means into 5 segments.
Wrote one-page profiles for each segment with a suggested marketing action.

projects.title: Airline On-Time Performance Analysis
bullets: Loaded 7M public US flight records into PostgreSQL and measured on-time rates by airline, airport and hour.
Built a Tableau story showing that delays late in the day mostly came from earlier delays carrying forward.
Wrote a short memo ranking the 5 airports where schedule padding would help most.
